messages.campaign_fixture.quest.bargaining.title: The price of provisions
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.bargaining.descri: Arrange a personal purchase with the quartermaster.
I have provisions for travelers. We can discuss a price.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.bargaining.remind: Ask me about the supplies when you are ready to buy or bargain.
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.bargaining.report: Your supplies are ready. Safe travels.
Ask about the supplies you bought
You can accept my terms or try to bargain. The choice is yours.
For you, {campaign_transaction_buyer}, I can make it {campaign_transaction_price} emeralds.
I have to hold to my price, {campaign_transaction_buyer}. That is {campaign_transaction_price} emeralds.
Here are your supplies, {campaign_transaction_buyer}. Your payment of {campaign_transaction_price} emeralds is settled.
You have already collected your supplies. I hope they serve you well.
Come back if you change your mind.
